req.title: Player payload includes position
req.statement: The system shall include the position field on every player response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-034 requires that every player response from GET /players/{id} includes the 'position' field. We need: (1) a positive test confirming a known player returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty 'position' field matching the fixture data exactly; (2) a negative test confirming that requesting a non-existent UUID returns HTTP 404 (error pathway); (3) a boundary test using the first player (squad 1) and last player (squad 26) by UUID to confirm position is present at the dataset edges. Additional tests cover: exact field value assertion to catch constant/string mutations, camelCase serialization of the field name, and the 404 path to catch status-code mutations.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_position_field_positive
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Player with squad_number=10 (Messi) exists with position='Right Winger'
actions: GET /players/{id} using Messi's known UUID from fixture
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_position_field_positive():
    messi_id = 'acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{messi_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'position' in body
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['id'] == messi_id
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10

test_get_player_by_id_includes_position_field_positive()

tests.name: test_get_player_position_field_not_null_and_exact_value
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Multiple players with distinct positions exist
actions: GET /players/{id} for three players with different positions
Assert each returns HTTP 200 with exact position string
expected: position field present and non-empty for each player
position values match fixture data exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response — decision table covering multiple position types
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_position_field_not_null_and_exact_value():
    cases = [
        ('0293b282-1da8-562e-998e-83849b417a42', 'Central Midfield', 7),
        ('38bae91d-8519-55a2-b30a-b9fe38849bfb', 'Centre-Forward', 9),
        ('d5f7dd7a-1dcb-5960-ba27-e34865b63358', 'Centre-Back', 19),
    ]
    for player_id, expected_position, expected_squad in cases:
        r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        body = r.json()
        assert 'position' in body
        assert body['position'] == expected_position
        assert body['position'] != ''
        assert body['squadNumber'] == expected_squad

test_get_player_position_field_not_null_and_exact_value()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_response_schema_includes_position_key_camel_case():
    damian_id = '01772c59-43f0-5d85-b913-c78e4e281452'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{damian_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
